description.en: Automates recruitment workflows for HR and headhunters, including sourcing, screening, resume evaluation, interview scheduling, and candidate tracking.
description.zh: 给 HR / 猎头的 AI 招聘工作流：岗位标准梳理、Boss直聘 + 猎聘双通道寻源初筛、市场人才盘点、简历评估、约面试、候选人台账与日报。可装成 Claude Code 插件或 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 插件——后者自带可直接上手操作的「招聘浏览器」面板；也能配合任意读 AGENTS.md 的 AI 编程助手使用。

description.en: Registers one Chinese government official-document (公文) writing skill: the 15 statutory document types plus routine materials, document-type and addressee-direction checks, an outline-before-draft flow, GB/T 9704-2012 layout checks, and a JSON-to-.docx exporter.
description.zh: 注册一份中文公文写作技能：覆盖 15 种法定公文与常见事务性材料，先判文种与行文方向、出大纲再逐段成稿，按 GB/T 9704-2012 核对版式，并可把成稿导出为 .docx。

description.en: Controls Chrome through the BrowserPaw CLI and Agent Skill, and keeps self-learned site workflows in ~/.browserpaw.
description.zh: 通过 BrowserPaw CLI 与 Agent Skill 操控 Chrome，并在 ~/.browserpaw 中保存可自动路由的自学习站点工作流。

description.en: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏补上官方缺失的「删除会话」，并在底部提供「清理分组」批量面板：运行中置灰、二次确认、注册表与磁盘真删除。 Delete-session action + workspace cleanup panel for the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 侧栏补上官方缺失的删除会话功能，运行中置灰、二次确认、真删除。

description.en: DSH 第一人称体验与本体记忆插件：把流程事件编译成角色的体验点滴，并从交付/实体/任务线维度建立可回查的工作记忆（SQLite），在模型步骤前注入「此刻状态 + 刚发生的 + 被勾起的回忆 + 正在推进的事」。
Connect your own machines to a DSH Web deployment and run commands on them from the agent.
description.zh: 把自己手边的 Mac、Windows、Linux 电脑接入 DSH Web 部署，让智能体直接在这些电脑上执行命令。

description.en: dsh-interactive-courseware 课件放映厅 把一节课的讲义交给 agent，还你一套能直接上课的翻页互动课件——播放器、页面骨架、打包脚本、机械盘点、单文件打包、档案预览全部内置，零 API 密钥。课件放映厅：把一节课的讲义做成翻页互动课件（dsh 全形态插件：skill 快照+机械盘点+单文件打包+真实播放器预览）
DSH LEWIS ENCHANTMENT · 附魔台｜开机动画：铺满当前窗口的完整开场、自定义视频与封面、启动检查更新和磨砂提示。
装/更插件后自动重启 DSH 并回到原会话：检测 profile 插件文件变化，一直等所有会话空闲且最近活动安静，由常驻后台看门狗（登录自启、不碰 WMI）或 WMI 守护先杀主进程再拉起（可最大化窗口），带冷却、试运行、日志和右侧原生侧边栏面板。

Incremental context compaction plugin for long conversations in DeepSeek Harness, condensing earlier dialogue into structured checkpoint summaries, retaining user requirements and task progress, and archiving original messages and attachments locally for history search and reading as needed. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 长对话的增量式上下文压缩插件，将较早对话整理为结构化检查点摘要，保留用户要求与任务进度，并将原始消息与附件归档到本地以供按需历史搜索与读取。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness（DSH）社区插件：统一管理工具与技能的常驻、按需和禁用策略，提供重复调用提醒、交替循环识别、无进展局部保护及本次启动统计。
description.zh: 统一管理工具和技能的常驻、按需与禁用策略，自动识别重复调用和死循环，防止 AI 空转。

description.en: Community-maintained ARS port for DeepSeek Harness with research and writing skills, native Team review and pipeline workflows, and workspace-scoped status and integrity tools.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的社区维护版 ARS 移植，提供文献研究与写作技能、原生 Team 评审和论文流程，以及限于会话工作区的状态与完整性工具。

description.en: A dry-dock theme for DeepSeek Harness with a workspace dashboard, a session-status companion, draft recovery, and Markdown export.
description.zh: 四号船坞为 DeepSeek Harness 提供干船坞主题、工作区概览、会话状态挂件、草稿恢复和 Markdown 导出。

description.en: One place for the window background, the intro clip and the screensaver, with a shared material library. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把窗口背景、开机片头和屏保收在一处管，共用一份素材库。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Shows the machine DSH runs on in the sidebar account row: laptops get the model name, battery percentage and a macOS-style charging glyph; iMac, Mac mini, Windows desktops and NAS boxes (Synology, ZSpace, UGREEN, fnOS) get their own outlined device icon. Degrades through full model, product family and icon-only as the row narrows, and never truncates the user name.
description.zh: 在侧栏账号行显示 DSH 所在机器的型号与供电状态：笔记本显示机型、电量百分比和 macOS 风格电池图标；iMac、Mac mini、Windows 台式机与 NAS（群晖、极空间、绿联、飞牛）显示各自的线性设备图标。空间不足时按完整型号 → 产品简称 → 仅图标三级降级，且永不压缩用户名。

description.en: A Closure desktop pet based on fan creation of Arknights: desk pet animations, daily interactions, pixel balance and spending bubbles, click interactions, and animation switching that follows DSH work status.
description.zh: 基于《明日方舟》二次创作的可露希尔桌宠：桌宠动画、日常交互、像素余额与花费气泡、点击互动，并跟随 DSH 工作状态切换动画。

description.en: Automatic backup of your sessions, configs, agent files and plugin data to your Aliyun Drive. Overwritten files keep an old copy automatically, and workspace names you edited are never replaced. Sign in with a QR scan, and bring the whole environment and its plugins back on a new machine. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 自动备份，会话、配置、Agent 文件、插件数据，到你的阿里云盘。被覆盖的文件自动留一份旧版，你改过的工作区名字不会被冲掉。扫码即可登录，换台电脑也能把整套环境和插件装回来。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Adds a user-chosen default workspace for new conversations, lists recent conversations above the workspace groups, and hides the default workspace from the lower groups to avoid duplication. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 为新会话增加可自定义的默认工作区，在侧栏顶部显示最近对话，并把默认工作区从下方工作区分组中隐藏，避免重复。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Seasons DeepSeek Harness replies with a light dialect flavor — Northeast, Tianjin, Beijing or Cantonese — behind a five-step frequency ladder (off to about 50%), three intensity levels, and a per-session switch beside the composer. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的回答偶尔掺一点方言口气（东北话、天津话、北京话、粤语），五档频率（关闭到约 50%）、三档强度，输入框旁可按会话单独切换。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Unified download entry for DeepSeek Harness: routes each URL by target to Motrix, built-in direct HTTP, yt-dlp or Hugging Face, and blocks shell write commands such as curl -o. Ships five tools — download, download_status, download_control, download_doctor, motrix_provision — plus a five-tab config page for engines, directories, mirrors and the write boundary.
description.zh: 统一下载入口：按目标把下载路由到 Motrix、内置直连、yt-dlp 与 Hugging Face，并把 curl -o 这类 shell 写盘命令拦下来。提供五个工具——download、download_status、download_control、download_doctor、motrix_provision——以及一个五页签配置中心，管理引擎、目录白名单、镜像与写盘边界。

description.en: A catalog of 1,692 public models across 75 vendors in the model picker and Models settings — every entry is fake and answers locally with a canned self-introduction, so nothing is sent to a provider and nothing is billed. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在模型选择器和设置页加入 75 家厂商、1692 条公开模型（2013 至 2026），全是假模型——不管问什么都会一本正经自报代号，由插件本地合成回复，不发推理请求、不扣真实余额，支持厂商分组、80 条分页、推理档位与全目录搜索。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Registers five Chinese prose-voice skills for fiction writing (jiangnan, fanhua, kuangbiao, tangxi, jinhua), each a Markdown instruction file covering sentence rhythm, imagery banks, dialogue technique, sample passages, taboos and a pre-writing checklist.
description.zh: 注册五套中文小说笔法技能（江南、繁花、狂飙、汤溪、婺州），每套是一份 Markdown 指令文件，讲句子节奏、意象库、对话技术、示范段落、禁区与写作前自检。

description.en: Sidebar library of every file sent to DeepSeek Harness: search it per workspace or across the host, open or preview a file without copying it, file a copy into the session workspace, and reuse it in a chat as an @library mention. Also exposes library_list, library_read and library_use tools to the agent. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏文件库：按工作区或全机检索所有发过的文件，可就地打开或预览、一键归档进会话工作区，并以 @library 在对话中复用；同时向 agent 提供 library_list / library_read / library_use 三个工具。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Linear-projection context compaction: near history stays verbatim, mid history becomes one fact line per block, far history keeps only keywords plus seq pointers. Every projection is rebuilt from the raw session log, so it never accumulates no matter how often it runs; anything cut stays recallable by seq or keyword.
description.zh: 线性投影压缩：近段保留原文、中段每块一条事实行、远段只留关键词加 seq 指针。每次投影都从会话原始日志重建，压多少次都不会变重；压掉的内容可按 seq 或关键词取回。

description.en: Compact long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness: a short boot block, details retrieved on demand, writes through tools. House rules get their own budget, and after compaction it checks which constraints were lost and warns at the start of the next turn. Mood and tidy reminders plus a self-wake mechanism, all modular and removable.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的紧凑长期记忆：开机只注入一小段，细节按需检索，写回走工具。家规有独立预算；压缩后回头核对哪些约束被压丢了，丢了在下一轮开头报警。另含心情与整理提醒、主动唤醒，全部模块化可删。

description.en: Group chat for DeepSeek Harness: one sidebar row and a WeChat-style panel where you and several agent sessions talk in the same room. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 让多个会话像微信群一样同屏聊天、讨论的 DSH 插件。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Read-only GitHub search for agents: repositories with a 1000-result paging window, code contents, issues and pull requests, and a derived trending query ranked by recent pushes and stars. Results collect in a right-sidebar panel split into repositories, code and issues, where cards expand to language mix, latest release and README, and can be starred across sessions, kept as a cross-session query history, or put two or three side by side for comparison. A token from the DSH credential store is sent only to github.com, api.github.com and hosts listed in trustedHosts.
description.zh: 给智能体用的只读 GitHub 检索：仓库（可翻页到 1000 条）、代码内容、issue 与 PR，以及按「最近推送加星标」推导的近期热门。结果收进右侧栏面板，分仓库、代码、议题三类，卡片可展开语言构成、最新 Release 与 README，支持跨会话星标收藏、检索历史，以及 2–3 个候选并排对比。令牌从 DSH 密钥库读取，只发送给 github.com、api.github.com 和 trustedHosts 里列出的主机。

description.en: Frosted-glass theme with six customizable titlebar glow presets, tinted cards, translucent popovers, and Google Sans typography across standalone, claude-style, and ds-bot modes.
description.zh: 卡片风格简约毛玻璃主题：内置六色可自定义标题栏顶光、彩色卡片开关、磨砂浮层与 Google Sans 字体排版，支持独立模式、dsh-claude-style 与 ds-bot。

description.en: Real-time captions: recognise system audio and the microphone, bilingual subtitles, translation between many languages, and meeting minutes in one click.
description.zh: 实时字幕：识别系统声音和麦克风，支持双语字幕，多种语言互译，一键生成会议纪要。

description.en: Markdown workbench in the right sidebar: lists the Markdown files of the session workspace, previews and edits them with a version-checked save, opens a file or folder dropped on the page (a skill directory included), and links the documents a file references so they open in the same panel.
description.zh: 右侧栏里的 Markdown 工作台：列出会话工作区里的 Markdown 文件，预览并编辑、保存时校验文件版本，可以把文件或文件夹（含技能目录）拖到页面上打开，文档里引用的其他文档点一下就在同一面板里打开。

description.en: Ranks the models connected to DeepSeek Harness by unit price and Artificial Analysis intelligence, lists priced market models that are not connected yet, and recommends the best-value picks in the composer model menu with one-click switching. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 按单价与 Artificial Analysis 智力分给当前接入的每个模型排名，同时列出尚未接入的市面模型，并在输入框模型菜单里推荐性价比最高的几个、支持一键切换。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: MWORKS AI for DeepSeek Harness: Syslab and Sysplorer MCP servers owned by the MCP manager, official MWORKS skills and working rules, and a Runtime environment section on the plugin page. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 MWORKS AI：由 MCP 管理器托管的 Syslab 与 Sysplorer MCP 服务、官方 MWORKS 技能与工作规则，并在插件页提供运行环境设置。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: A balance widget for the DSH web GUI, forked from MeteorNOX/DeepSeek-Balance-Whale-Widget, adding 9 One Piece character skins. Shows balance, today's usage and peak-valley price.
description.zh: 基于MeteorNOX小鲸鱼挂件二次开发的余额挂件，新增草帽一伙9位角色皮肤；显示余额、今日已用与每轮消耗（含峰谷价），泡泡内容可自定义，高效按事件推送

description.en: Turn a photo into a Q-style DSH pet: local cutout, a dsh-pet pack, and a seven-clip animation set, with built-in pets untouched. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把照片做成 Q 版桌宠：本地抠图、生成 dsh-pet 宠物包，并用程序化动作补齐全套动作，内置宠物不受影响。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: A sidebar entry showing your DeepSeek balance and token usage, with a 14-day chart, per-model grouping, a pinned primary model, and the official usage page opened inside the app. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 侧栏底部显示账户余额与 Token 用量，面板含近 14 天走势、按运营商/模型分组与主线设置，官方用量页可在应用内直接打开。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Plugin dashboard for DSH: every installed plugin in one list with a per-row power switch, a manual-or-auto flag that scopes the one-click bulk actions, and inline update badges. Updates are hot-swapped, so the new version takes effect without restarting DSH. Detects npm, GitHub, tarball and symlink installs. A second page lists, previews and toggles skills; it reads skill files but never modifies them. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DSH 插件管理台：所有已装插件一屏看完，每行一个开关；「手动/自动」标记决定一键批量操作的作用范围；有新版时行内标出并可单独更新。装完热替换，新版本当场生效、不用重启 DSH。能识别 npm、GitHub、压缩包、软链四种装法。另有一页列出、预览并开关技能，只读技能文件，不做任何修改。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Shows the PlusVibeAPI balance beside the composer, with today's and this month's spend, an estimate for the current chat, and a per-day spend chart; the API key stays in the Host process and only same-origin routes reach the page. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在输入框旁显示 PlusVibeAPI 余额，附今日与本月花费、本次对话的估算花费和每日花费图表；API 密钥只留在 Host 进程，页面只访问同源路由。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Adds fixed identity headers to model requests so a shared gateway or memory proxy recognizes the client instead of asking it to choose a team and an agent every session.
description.zh: 给模型请求补上固定身份头，让共享网关或记忆代理直接认得这个客户端，不用每个会话都选一次团队和 agent。

description.en: Adds a row of quick-phrase chips beside the composer whose captions and sent text are edited separately: a click either sends the phrase or inserts it at the cursor, per a setting, and always inserts at the cursor when the composer already holds a draft; the row folds into one pill while a draft exists and can be switched off from settings so that nothing renders at all; single phrases can be hidden on their own; the row sits below the composer, above it, or in the tool row; and a settings page covers adding, renaming, drag-reordering, two-step delete and resetting to defaults. All behaviour is one renderer-side script with no dependencies and no network requests, storing phrases in plain text in localStorage.
description.zh: 在输入框旁加一排快捷短语按钮：按钮名称与真正发送的内容分开编辑，点按行为可选「直接发送」或「插入光标处」，输入框里已有草稿时总是插到光标处；有草稿时整排缩成一个小胶囊，设置里关掉「显示短语行」后连胶囊都不渲染；单条短语也可单独隐藏；位置可选输入框下方、上方或工具行右侧；管理页支持新增、改名、拖动排序、两步确认删除与恢复默认。行为全部集中在一个渲染端脚本里，无依赖、不联网，短语以明文存在 localStorage。

description.en: Draft a reply beside selected chat text, combine multiple quotes in one reply, and remove individual quote replies from the composer.
description.zh: 划选会话文字后可在选区旁回复，同一条回复可以引用多段原文，并可在聊天框里逐条删除引用回复。

description.en: Recoverable session deletion for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar manager that moves sessions to a trash, restores or purges them, and reclaims the image attachments only those sessions referenced. Owner-only routes; attachment collection is skipped entirely when any remaining session log cannot be read.
description.zh: 给 DSH 补上可恢复的会话删除：左侧栏管理面板把会话移入回收站、恢复或彻底清除，并回收只有这些会话引用的图片附件。路由仅 owner 可用；只要有一个剩余会话日志读不出来，就整体放弃附件清理。

description.en: Cross-Session tools for DSH: session_list finds a Session by title, id or working directory; session_send hands one message to it (one-way, reply: true asks for the result back); session_read shows another Session's recent messages only when you ask; session_create opens a Session and hands it a first message; session_models lists the model routes available before you create one. Adds a Session message row to the / menu that inserts a Session chip into the composer.
description.zh: DSH 跨会话工具：session_list 按标题、id 或工作目录定位会话；session_send 单向投递一条消息（reply: true 请对方回报）；session_read 仅在你明确要求时读取近期消息；session_create 新建会话并交办首条消息；session_models 在新建前列出可用模型路由。`/` 菜单新增「会话消息」一行，把会话 chip 插入输入框。

description.en: Configure implementer and reviewer roles with per-role models, effort, prompts and work tools, then launch them in the current Harness session.
description.zh: 在当前 Harness 会话中配置并启动实现与复核两角色，支持分别设置模型、推理强度、提示词与工作工具集。

description.en: Reskins the DSH thinking row: pick an image, give that image its own line pool, and the row types the line out one character at a time with a highlight sweep, over a 2-4 colour gradient you control. Three packs ship in the box (39 images, 41 lines, 184 verbs). Everything is edited in Settings -> Thinking and lands on the next line, no restart, and packs import or export as .zip. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 给 DSH 的「思考状态」行换皮肤：一张图配自己的文案池，文字逐字打出、高光扫过，2–4 色渐变可调。内置三套（39 图 / 41 句 / 184 个动词）。在 设置 → 思考状态 里配，改完下一句话就生效，不用重启；套组可导入导出 .zip。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Workspace-shared L0-L3 SQLite memory for DeepSeek Harness: FTS5 plus optional local embeddings, evidence-gated recall with source and revision provenance, two-hop source-graph expansion, scene timelines, and private journals kept as Markdown files bound to one main session.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供按工作区共享的 L0-L3 SQLite 记忆：FTS5 与可选本地嵌入、带来源与修订出处的证据门槛召回、两跳来源图扩展、场景时间线，以及绑定单一主会话的 Markdown 私人日记。

description.en: Render acceleration for long, formula-heavy chat transcripts: offscreen blocks skip style and layout, idle animations stop repainting, with live switches in the Plugin Manager.
description.zh: 让超长、含大量公式的对话保持流畅：视口外消息块不再参与样式重算与布局，加载动画不再逐帧重绘，插件页开关即时生效。

description.en: Personal workbench for appraisal workflows: project and timesheet tracking, Tianyuan system integration (MCP/CLI), a floating assistant that queries Tianyuan via read-only MCP tools, and detail/declare table export with formula restore and print formatting.
description.zh: 评估业务个人工作台：项目与工时管理、天源系统对接（MCP/CLI）、浮动助手（经只读 MCP 工具直查天源数据）、明细表/申报表导出（含公式恢复与打印格式设置）。

description.en: Unifies long-term memory and past conversations across WorkBuddy, Qoder CN and DeepSeek Harness, and writes shared facts back into their Markdown memory files. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 统一 WorkBuddy、Qoder CN 与 DeepSeek Harness 的长期记忆和历史会话，并把共享事实写回两个应用自己的 Markdown 记忆文件。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Usage, token, cache, and cost statistics for DeepSeek Harness, with workspace and model breakdowns, per-turn history, price references, and CSV/Excel export. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DSH 使用量与费用统计：按工作区、模型和渠道拆分 Token 与消费，包含逐轮记录、价格表以及 CSV/Excel 导出。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Audits DSH session transcripts for reclaimable wait time — a background job started then blocked on, blind sleeps, independent commands split across turns, serially launched subagents, and slow commands run to timeout — sums those into one figure, and A/Bs a new conversation against an old one to report the speedup in percent.
description.zh: 审计 DSH 会话转录里的可回收等待——起了后台又阻塞等、盲等 sleep、可合并却被拆成多轮的分命令、分步启动的 subagent、慢命令前台跑到超时——汇总成一个可净省的时长，并用新对话对比旧对话报出加速百分比。

description.en: Adds six switches to the DSH settings page that send Windows notifications for approval waiting, questions, task completion, subtasks, errors and turn end. Each kind has an editable toast template and an optional detail line, such as the last reply of a finished turn or the tool an approval is about, and clicking a toast opens its session. DSH must stay running to deliver notifications.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置页提供六个开关，为审批等待、向你提问、任务完成、子任务完成、任务出错、轮次完成发送 Windows 通知；每一类都可以自定义横幅文案，并可选附带详情行（例如该轮最后一条回复、审批涉及的工具名），点击通知回到对应会话。接收通知需要 DSH 保持运行。

description.en: Browse workspace files in a right sidebar tab and add files or selected code lines to the session from context menus, with a line-selectable code preview.
description.zh: 在右侧边栏浏览工作区文件，通过右键菜单把文件或选中的代码行加入会话，代码预览支持按行号选择引用。

description.en: A yt_archive tool that turns a YouTube video link into a full caption archive via the 2100laike archive service: every available caption track (manual and auto-generated) is fetched into a per-language, timestamped Markdown snapshot that survives video deletion or going private; already-archived videos return the latest snapshot without spending quota, and terminal fetch failures (no captions / unavailable video) are reported early instead of timing out. Needs the third-party 2100laike service; anonymous use is limited to 8 archives per day per plugin instance and a registered PAT raises that to 100 per day.
description.zh: yt_archive 工具：把 YouTube 视频链接经 2100laike 存档服务转成字幕全文存档——全部语言字幕轨道（人工+自动生成）抓成按语言分节、带时间戳的 Markdown 快照，视频删除或转私密后仍可读；已存档的视频去重秒回不耗额度，终态失败（无字幕/视频不可用）提前报告而不是等到超时。依赖第三方 2100laike 存档服务；匿名使用每个插件实例每天限 8 次，注册后配置 PAT 可提升到每天 100 次。

description.en: A ChatGPT-like chat layer for DeepSeek Harness with seamless Chat/Agent handoff and cross-platform memory migration.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供类 ChatGPT 的聊天体验，支持 Chat/Agent 无缝切换与跨平台记忆迁移。

description.en: An explorable atlas of the Three-Body trilogy: 56 characters with 247 curated relations, 46 plot beats, 52 events across 10 eras, 24 technologies, 19 places, 37 glossary terms and 5 reading paths, plus a real velocity-Verlet gravity simulation that derives stable and chaotic eras, catastrophes and civilization generations from the planet radiation flux. Registers 10 agent tools and gates every view by a spoiler tier. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 三体三部曲可探索图鉴：56 位人物与 247 条关系、46 个情节节点、10 个纪元的 52 个事件、24 件技术、19 个地点、37 条术语与 5 条导读路线，以及一个真正运行的引力模拟，由行星辐射通量推出恒纪元/乱纪元、灾变与文明代数。注册 10 个对话工具，全部视图可按剧透层级遮蔽。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Logs what each AI turn changed inside the folders you point it at — which files were created, deleted or modified, and which tool call most likely did it. Never reads file contents.
description.zh: 记录每一轮对话在观测目录里改了什么：哪些文件被新建、删除或修改，大致是哪次工具调用干的。不读文件内容。

description.en: Manage relay day cards from the DSH sidebar. Paste a seller delivery message to write the model route and store the API key, then see per-card token usage, an expiry countdown and the cost against DeepSeek official prices, with a one-click fix for context-window truncation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧栏管理中转站日卡。粘贴发货信息即可写入模型路由并保存密钥，随后按卡查看 token 用量、到期倒计时和对照官方价的费用，并一键修复上下文窗口导致的输出截断。

description.en: [FROZEN 2026-10-31] HS Top-3 candidates, 12-element completeness, RVC check and tariff version gate.
description.zh: 自动筛出 HS 编码前三候选，校验 12 项要素是否齐全，并核对 RVC 与关税版本，避免报关出错。

description.en: Custom-model console for the Models page: manage hand-declared llm-pi-ai providers in one list, fetch the model list an endpoint serves, and fill each model context window, max output and the reasoning levels the endpoint accepts straight into the configuration. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 「设置 → 模型」里的自定义模型控制台：一处管理手写的 llm-pi-ai 提供商，向端点索取模型清单，并把每个模型的真实上下文窗口、输出上限与端点接受的推理档位直接写进配置。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。
